explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/918: Erdős–Hajnal proved that for every finite k there is a graph with chromatic number ℵ₁ in which every subgraph on fewer than ℵ_k vertices has χ ≤ ℵ₀. The statement adds the hypotheses from [ErHa68b, Cor. 1], namely GCH (2^c = succ c for infinite c) and |V| = ℵ_k, and the docstring documents this. It asserts such a G for each k ≥ 1, quantifying over induced subgraphs, which is equivalent for '≤ ℵ₀'. Faithful.
